_meta.title: The Teachings of the Lord Jesus
_meta.arrangement: Editorial. There is no canonical enumeration of Jesus' teachings; the parables are a stable category and the discourses are not. Ordered canonically. Entries come from the text's own divisions (Matthew's five discourses, John's discourses), from the sermon corpus's own series, and from Nave's Topical Bible life-of-Christ outline.
